heading: Real routines, *pretty frames.*
paragraphs: I'm a creator who loves the little rituals: a skincare routine that actually works, an outfit that makes a Tuesday feel special, a slow Sunday reset with good coffee.
I film content the way people really use products, so your brand shows up as something viewers want in their own lives, not as an ad they scroll past.

Right now my boyfriend and I are travelling country to country, filming as we go, before we settle down in Cape Town in 2027. That means fresh locations, hotels and backdrops for your content, wherever we are that month.
kit: Shot on iPhone with natural light, a ring light for beauty close-ups, and a lot of love for soft, clean edits.
